value.rationale: In a minimal three-reaction positive chemical center with a line of extinction equilibria, the theorem identifies the full original-time boundary between persistent oscillation and extinction, a rational boundary pulse and exact critical slowdown. A constant per-cycle integral of first-species concentration despite infinite limiting period is a physically meaningful mass-processing invariant and the distribution provides a testable time-sampling law. Not merely a known center deduction or arbitrary parameter cut.
